title: I Followed the Flu-Clinic Sticker After They Called My Slot a Walk-In

parts.text: I followed the flu-clinic sticker at 10:14 a.m. after they called my slot a walk-in. The wristband said 10:10. I was twenty-nine, patient, standing in a line that made me look like I owned the wait. I photographed the sticker, the wristband, and the kiosk still. The desk restored the slot and dated the walk-in as a no. I keep the kiosk still. The line finally knows a slot from a walk-in.

social.video_title: The flu clinic called my timed slot a walk-in — Part 1/1
social.description: Wristband 10:10, a walk-in call, a kiosk still. The desk restored the slot. Has a clinic ever erased your time?
